verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י לַֽיהוָה֙ רִ֤יב עִם־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֠י אֵין־ אֱמֶ֧ת וְֽאֵין־ חֶ֛סֶד וְאֵֽין־ דַּ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî Yah·weh rîḇ ‘im- yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ kî ’ên- ’ĕ·meṯ wə·’ên- ḥe·seḏ wə·’ên- da·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Hear the word of the LORD O children of Israel for the LORD has a case against the people of the land . . . There is no truth no loving devotion and no knowledge of God in the land

verses.original: אָלֹ֣ה וְכַחֵ֔שׁ וְרָצֹ֥חַ וְגָנֹ֖ב וְנָאֹ֑ף פָּרָ֕צוּ וְדָמִ֥ים בְּדָמִ֖ים נָגָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·lōh wə·ḵa·ḥêš wə·rā·ṣō·aḥ wə·ḡā·nōḇ wə·nā·’ōp̄ pā·rā·ṣū wə·ḏā·mîm bə·ḏā·mîm nā·ḡā·‘ū
verses.literal: Cursing and lying murder and stealing and adultery are rampant one act of bloodshed . . . follows another

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל כָּל־ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ וְאֻמְלַל֙ בְּחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־ דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם יֵאָסֵֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên hā·’ā·reṣ te·’ĕ·ḇal kāl- yō·wō·šêḇ bāh wə·’um·lal bə·ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim wə·ḡam- də·ḡê hay·yām yê·’ā·sê·p̄ū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the land mourns and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air even the fish of the sea disappear

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אַל־ אִ֛ישׁ יָרֵ֖ב וְאַל־ אִ֑ישׁ יוֹכַ֣ח וְעַמְּךָ֖ כִּמְרִיבֵ֥י כֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’al- ’îš yā·rêḇ wə·’al- ’îš yō·w·ḵaḥ wə·‘am·mə·ḵā kim·rî·ḇê ḵō·hên
verses.literal: But let no man contend let no man offer reproof for your people [are] like those who contend with a priest

verses.original: וְכָשַׁלְתָּ֣ הַיּ֔וֹם נָבִ֛יא גַּם־ וְכָשַׁ֧ל עִמְּךָ֖ לָ֑יְלָה וְדָמִ֖יתִי אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·šal·tā hay·yō·wm nā·ḇî gam- wə·ḵā·šal ‘im·mə·ḵā lā·yə·lāh wə·ḏā·mî·ṯî ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: You will stumble by day and the prophet . . . will stumble with you by night so I will destroy your mother

verses.original: עַמִּ֖י נִדְמ֥וּ מִבְּלִ֣י הַדָּ֑עַת כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה מָאַ֗סְתָּ הַדַּ֣עַת וְאֶמְאָֽסְאךָ֙ מִכַּהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וַתִּשְׁכַּח֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אָֽנִי׃ גַּם־ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח בָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî niḏ·mū mib·bə·lî had·dā·‘aṯ kî- ’at·tāh mā·’as·tā had·da·‘aṯ wə·’em·’ā·sə·ḵā mik·ka·hên lî wat·tiš·kaḥ tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ā·nî gam- ’eš·kaḥ bā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge Because you have rejected knowledge I will also reject you as My priests Since you have forgotten the law of your God I will also forget your children

verses.original: כְּרֻבָּ֖ם כֵּ֣ן חָֽטְאוּ־ לִ֑י אָמִֽיר׃ כְּבוֹדָ֖ם בְּקָל֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: kə·rub·bām kên ḥā·ṭə·’ū- lî ’ā·mîr kə·ḇō·w·ḏām bə·qā·lō·wn
verses.literal: The more they multiplied . . . the more they sinned against Me they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace

verses.original: יֹאכֵ֑לוּ חַטַּ֥את עַמִּ֖י יִשְׂא֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ וְאֶל־ עֲוֺנָ֖ם
verses.literal: They feed on the sins of My people and set their hearts on iniquity

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה כָעָ֖ם כַּכֹּהֵ֑ן וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עָלָיו֙ דְּרָכָ֔יו אָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃ וּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵā·‘ām kak·kō·hên ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ā·lāw də·rā·ḵāw ’ā·šîḇ lōw ū·ma·‘ă·lā·lāw
verses.literal: And it shall be like people like priest I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds

verses.original: וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔עוּ הִזְנ֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יִפְרֹ֑צוּ כִּֽי־ אֶת־ עָזְב֖וּ יְהוָ֥ה לִשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵə·lū wə·lō yiś·bā·‘ū hiz·nū wə·lō yip̄·rō·ṣū kî- ’eṯ- ‘ā·zə·ḇū Yah·weh liš·mōr
verses.literal: They will eat but not be satisfied they will be promiscuous but not multiply For - they have abandoned the LORD to give themselves
to promiscuity wine and new wine which take away understanding

verses.original: עַמִּי֙ יִשְׁאָ֔ל בְּעֵצ֣וֹ וּמַקְל֖וֹ יַגִּ֣יד ל֑וֹ כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ הִתְעָ֔ה וַיִּזְנ֖וּ מִתַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî yiš·’āl bə·‘ê·ṣōw ū·maq·lōw yag·gîḏ lōw kî rū·aḥ zə·nū·nîm hiṯ·‘āh way·yiz·nū mit·ta·ḥaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: My people consult their wooden idols and their divining rods inform them For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God

verses.original: יְזַבֵּ֗חוּ עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֨י הֶהָרִ֜ים יְקַטֵּ֔רוּ וְעַל־ הַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תַּ֣חַת אַלּ֧וֹן וְלִבְנֶ֛ה וְאֵלָ֖ה כִּ֣י צִלָּ֑הּ ט֣וֹב עַל־ כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם תִּזְנֶ֙ינָה֙ וְכַלּוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תְּנָאַֽפְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·zab·bê·ḥū ‘al- rā·šê he·hā·rîm yə·qaṭ·ṭê·rū wə·‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ta·ḥaṯ ’al·lō·wn wə·liḇ·neh wə·’ê·lāh kî ṣil·lāh ṭō·wḇ ‘al- kên bə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem tiz·ne·nāh wə·ḵal·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem tə·nā·’ap̄·nāh
verses.literal: They sacrifice on the mountaintops . . . and burn offerings on the hills under oak poplar and terebinth because their shade is pleasant And so . . . your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery

verses.original: לֹֽא־ אֶפְק֨וֹד עַל־ בְּנוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם כִּ֣י תִזְנֶ֗ינָה וְעַל־ כַּלּֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ כִּ֣י תְנָאַ֔פְנָה כִּי־ הֵם֙ יְפָרֵ֔דוּ עִם־ הַזֹּנ֣וֹת יְזַבֵּ֑חוּ וְעִם־ הַקְּדֵשׁ֖וֹת וְעָ֥ם לֹֽא־ יָבִ֖ין יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ep̄·qō·wḏ ‘al- bə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem kî ṯiz·ne·nāh wə·‘al- kal·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem kî ṯə·nā·’ap̄·nāh kî- hêm yə·p̄ā·rê·ḏū ‘im- haz·zō·nō·wṯ yə·zab·bê·ḥū wə·‘im- haq·qə·ḏê·šō·wṯ wə·‘ām lō- yā·ḇîn yil·lā·ḇêṭ
verses.literal: I will not punish . . . your daughters when they prostitute themselves nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes So a people without understanding will come to ruin

verses.original: אִם־ אַתָּה֙ זֹנֶ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יְהוּדָ֑ה אַל־ יֶאְשַׁ֖ם וְאַל־ תָּבֹ֣אוּ הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל תַּעֲלוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן וְאַל־ וְאַֽל־ תִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ יְהוָֽה׃ חַי־
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’at·tāh zō·neh yiś·rā·’êl yə·hū·ḏāh ’al- ye’·šam wə·’al- tā·ḇō·’ū hag·gil·gāl ta·‘ă·lū bêṯ ’ā·wen wə·’al- wə·’al- tiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū Yah·weh ḥay-
verses.literal: Though you prostitute yourself O Israel may Judah avoid such guilt Do not journey to Gilgal do not go up vvv to Beth-aven . . . and do not swear on oath As surely as the LORD lives

verses.original: כִּ֚י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל סֹֽרֵרָ֔ה סָרַ֖ר כְּפָרָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה עַתָּה֙ יִרְעֵ֣ם כְּכֶ֖בֶשׂ בַּמֶּרְחָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiś·rā·’êl sō·rê·rāh sā·rar kə·p̄ā·rāh Yah·weh ‘at·tāh yir·‘êm kə·ḵe·ḇeś bam·mer·ḥāḇ
verses.literal: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow
Ephraim is joined to idols leave him alone

verses.original: סָבְאָ֑ם סָ֖ר הַזְנֵ֣ה הִזְנ֔וּ מָגִנֶּֽיהָ׃ הֵב֛וּ אָהֲב֥וּ קָל֖וֹן
verses.transliteration: sā·ḇə·’ām sār haz·nêh hiz·nū mā·ḡin·ne·hā hê·ḇū ’ā·hă·ḇū qā·lō·wn
verses.literal: When their liquor is gone they turn to prostitution . . . their rulers . . . dearly love disgrace

verses.original: ר֛וּחַ צָרַ֥ר אוֹתָ֖הּ בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ מִזִּבְחוֹתָֽםס וְיֵבֹ֖שׁוּ
verses.literal: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings and their sacrifices will bring them shame
